resources.string: MediaFlow is designed as an ad-free alternative to Snaptube, with a distinctive experience.\n\nUse it lawfully and responsibly, respecting content owners’ rights and platform terms.
Do not use it in ways that displease God.

Some online videos, including some Facebook videos, require you to sign in before you can watch or download them.\n\nWhen needed, sign in through MediaFlow’s built-in browser to access content available to your account and download it where permitted.
